headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 12, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a thrilling comeback in a closely contested matchup against the Milwaukee Brewers, winning 7-6. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a grand slam and 6 RBIs. In another closely contested game, the Pirates edged out the Brewers 3-2, with Valdez leading the Brewers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Zac Gallen has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation, effective retroactive to July 9, 2026. Chris Martin has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right shoulder impingement, while Nick Lodolo is out with a blister on his left index finger. William Kempner has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a right elbow sprain, and Brandon Woodruff has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place. Braden Shewmake has been traded to the Milwaukee Brewers, while Jacob Gonzalez and Brandon Eisert have been traded to the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Chicago White Sox traded Jaden Woods to the Pirates, and the Minnesota Twins acquired Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling Comeback**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6 in a closely contested matchup. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a grand slam and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Brewers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 3-2 in a closely contested game. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Angels Fall Short in Minnesota**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels dropped a 3-5 decision to the Minnesota Twins, marking their loss in the matchup. Royce Lewis led the Twins' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Joe Ryan pitched 6 strong innings for the Twins.

top_news.title: **Athletics Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox edged the Athletics 1-0, securing a narrow victory. Chase Meidroth led the Athletics' offense with 2 hits, 1 RBI, and a key double that scored a run.

top_news.title: **Gallen Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks right-hander Zac Gallen has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation, effective retroactive to July 9, 2026.

top_news.title: **Shewmake Joins Brewers in Trade**
top_news.summary: Braden Shewmake has been traded to the Milwaukee Brewers. The shortstop was previously acquired by the Brewers in a trade with the Houston Astros.
